bugs.description: Control anomaly: rotation is misapplied or amplified under a specific traversal context.
Transition anomaly: entering a designated traversal zone triggers an unintended position reset/teleport.
Traversal anomaly: movement commands are suppressed in a specific zone.
Physics anomaly: collision or jump response produces an abnormal impulse.
Sequence anomaly: a valid action sequence fails only under a specific contextual condition.
Interaction anomaly: an otherwise valid interaction fails to trigger its expected event in context.
World-state anomaly: a valid interaction causes an unintended block/object state mutation.
Control anomaly: movement is suppressed only under a specific camera-angle and environmental condition.
Inventory anomaly: slot selection is unexpectedly overridden under a specific contextual condition.
Break-event anomaly: attacking a target causes unintended object-state corruption rather than a normal break result.
